scope: Targeted synthetic regression cases and a small manual audit, not an independent accuracy benchmark.
manual_findings: Earlier self-review approved overstated corporate motive, sector-to-national-economy scope, and controls-to-financial-stability claims. Stricter review rejected those three sampled drafts.
Historical statistics need explicit time qualifiers. Both generator and reviewer now require them.
Optional significance can be omitted only after the remaining factual summary passes review.
Sparse-input source-omission filler and repetitive significance still occur. The current checks do not prove prose quality or factual accuracy on unseen news.

A second convenience sample still raised estimate/tense and attribution concerns after model approval. A more aggressive reviewer was not adopted because it also made questionable objections. Human reading remains part of the release checkpoint.
limitations: Same-model generation and review can share errors. Human publication review remains required.
Synthetic fixture labels were authored for this change; ten grouping cases and nine reviewer cases are narrow regression evidence.

additional_qualifier_challenge.limit: Follow-up to a convenience sample of ten fresh analyses, not a labeled benchmark. Candidate made some questionable literalism objections; additional rejection is not proof of improved accuracy.

grouping_scale_experiment.adopted_method: Global lexical/identity candidates, then bounded independent pair verdicts. Only approved semantic edges form groups.
limitations: Top-two lexical candidate recall can miss paraphrases; exact identity anchors only guarantee comparison, not a match.
Grouping and historical update judgments remain model decisions.
